hotspot_events.summary: Nvidia's board voted unanimously on Nov 23 to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO, president and director, effective immediately, with public support from Trump; NVDA closed at $165.05 (+31.48%, +$39.52), adding roughly $952 billion in market value in a single day, while the Nasdaq rose 6.5% and the S&P 500 4.7%; the independent board investigation continues, with closed-door House meetings on Dec 1 and public Senate testimony on Dec 3 proceeding as scheduled and the 10-Q statutory deadline around Dec 4.
hotspot_events.title: Nvidia board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO, NVDA up 31.48% in a single day

meta.note: Tuesday briefing. Three top stories: Nvidia's board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO (NVDA +31.48% to $165.05), copper spot premiums plunge off a cliff (SMM average CNY 3,350/t), and the Ga/Ge/Sb suspension expires Nov 27 — 3 days left. Event library: 8 timeline entries added, 1 new event created (Daikin R32 retrofit plan). Tier B batch 9: 11 subcategories, 8 with hits. Refrigerant spot: no verified Nov 23 range, so this issue's JSON omits refrigerant_spot (no stale values carried over).

siphon_effects.detail: Nvidia reinstatement and a breather for the AI trade: NVDA up 31.48% in a single day, adding roughly $952 billion in market value, Nasdaq +6.5% — the AI compute demand signal is unchanged; but with the 10-Q still unfiled and hearings ahead, volatility is not over.

TrendForce on Nov 19 sharply cut its NAND forecast: Q4 contract-price gains cut from +15%–20% to +8%–13%, 1Q27 at 0% to -5% and turning down from 2Q27; general DRAM Q4 at +10%–15% unchanged; Micron says 75% of its 2027 supply is already sold out; spot 512Gb NAND wafers at $14.30, -32% for the quarter; Micron -13.89% and SanDisk -16.06% on Nov 20.

No new developments in the window; last week's wording stands: Samsung Electro-Mechanics Q4 consumer X5R quotes +25%–30%, AI-grade X6S +10%–20% (TrendForce estimate); Q3 MLCC average prices +21.4% year on year, lead times 40 weeks; DigiKey's Nov 8 quotes showed 7 Samsung Electro-Mechanics MLCCs at 61-week lead times.

Kingboard's Nov 20 letter on a seventh price hike this year circulated online (FR-4 CCL +10% across the board, prepreg thick cloth +10% / thin cloth +20%), unconfirmed by Kingboard's official site, and another account says Kingboard has already raised prices eight times this year — conflicting round counts, pending verification; Shengyi's November increases have landed (M6 +15%, PP +25%), with orders scheduled into January 2027; still no restart news from Panasonic's Hukou plant.
siphon_effects.source: A-share market reports, Nov 20, 2026; PCBA-HYH, Nov 17, 2026

siphon_effects.detail: Daikin's R32 retrofit solution (see Section 1, item 1); Lenovo's Q2 AI server backlog of CNY 530 billion (Nov 19, one day outside the window).

Nucor announced on Nov 23 a spot hot-rolled coil price of $1,330/short ton (+$20) for this week, its 18th consecutive weekly increase, with lead times of 3–5 weeks; SMU spot hot-rolled coil quoted Nov 17 at $1,390/short ton (+$15 on the week, +$110 on the month); Dimensional Metals raised plate / coil prices +4%–5% effective Nov 23 (Steel Market Update, Nov 23; SMU, Nov 17)

Kingboard's Nov 20 letter on a seventh price hike this year circulated online (FR-4 +10%, prepreg thick cloth +10% / thin cloth +20%), unconfirmed by the official site, with conflicting round counts pending verification; Shengyi's November increases have landed (M6 +15%, PP +25%), with orders scheduled to January 2027; still no restart news from Panasonic's Hukou plant (A-share market reports, Nov 20; PCBA-HYH, Nov 17)

TrendForce cut its NAND forecast on Nov 19: Q4 contract-price gains cut from +15%–20% to +8%–13%, 1Q27 at 0% to -5% and turning down from 2Q27; general DRAM Q4 at +10%–15% unchanged; spot 512Gb NAND wafers at $14.30, -32% for the quarter (TrendForce via AInvest, Nov 19)

No new developments in the window; Samsung Electro-Mechanics Q4 consumer X5R +25%–30%, AI-grade X6S +10%–20% (TrendForce estimate); lead times 40 weeks; DigiKey's Nov 8 quotes showed 7 Samsung Electro-Mechanics MLCCs at 61-week lead times (MoneyToday, Nov 18; The Inference, Nov 12)

Supplyframe's interconnect price index for October was 169.5 (+1.5% month on month, +28.9% year on year), expected to rise 9.3% in November to 185.3 (second-highest in nearly five years); overall lead times 12–21 weeks, high-current power connectors 22–32 weeks (Supplyframe via Findchips, Nov 11–12)

ST's fourth-round price adjustment remains rumored and unconfirmed (effective Jan 1, 2027, per a November LinkedIn industry update citing reports); NXP's third round (Nov 2 letter) and Renesas's (September letter) both take effect Jan 1, 2027, unchanged; Infineon has raised prices on some power products twice this year, and its CEO said on Nov 10 that high-performance SiC and high-power module supply is tight (LinkedIn November update, NextPCB Nov 12, BigGo Nov 17)

Siemens China's DI product list-price adjustment took effect Nov 1 (S7-1500 CPUs up ~15% on average, etc.); FY27 industrial-control and power-distribution list prices take effect Dec 1, with orders placed before then deliverable by Dec 31 at the latest (distributor forward, Oct 23, no official release seen); Schneider / ABB / Chint / Delixi issued no new letters

LATO interviews: grid connection is the most-cited cause of data-center delays, with large transformers taking 2+ years to arrive; medium-voltage switchgear 52–80 weeks, pad-mount transformers 40–65 weeks, substation transformers 90–160 weeks, large power transformers 160–210 weeks (LATO, around Nov 19)

This round (batch 9): 11 subcategories, 8 with hits — the connector price index is expected to rise 9.3% month on month in November to 185.3, steel-plate processing keeps rising (Nucor hot-rolled coil up for an 18th straight week), corrugated packaging up CNY 50/t at Nine Dragons' Taicang plant from Nov 13, Crane gate valves up across the board effective Nov 1, Gastite rubber fittings +6% effective Nov 23, network-switch chip lead times 40–56 weeks, wire connectors as per the connector category, sensor lead times 26+ weeks; 3 items checked with no anomalies (Burners, Isolators, Fans & Blowers)
